title: Brutus
subtitle: Lumbridge cow field, NE corner
facts: Melee from the tile east of his spawn. He never charges into a wall from there.
Piety + Protect from Melee. Protection only blocks his basic hit; specials ignore it.
Super combat, a few prayer potions, a little food, air runes, tinderbox (burn his oak logs between kills).
South of the pen between the two troughs, touching the fence. He stomps if you stand only one tile away.

items.title: Charge.
items.text: 4-tile dash after 3 ticks. Step to the side.

items.title: Slam.
items.text: Hits the tiles in front 3 times after 4 ticks. Step back one tile.

items.title: Pathing.
items.text: Out of range too long, he walks around obstacles to reach you. Re-safespot.

caHow.635: Drink potions before he spawns; prayers are fine. Take off the cowbell amulet too (the wiki doesn't say if it counts).
caHow.636: Trough safespot with the blowpipe. Move and re-safespot on *growls* or *huff*.
caHow.634: [[Dragon halberd]] spec {have:Dragon halberd}. Kill him once first, then spec as he spawns. Also completes Smarter than a Cow.
